problem: Lucy reads $6$ pages of her new book each day. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the number of pages $P(t)$ Lucy has left to read? Assume that the time $t$ is measured in days.

feedback.problem: During the winter months, the energy consumption of an average household increases by $1\,\text{kWh}$ every week. What differential equation describes the rate of change of energy consumption $E(t)$ (measured in $\text{kWh}$) of an average household during these months? Assume that the time $t$ is measured in weeks.
feedback.worked_solution:
If the energy consumption of an average household is $E\,\text{kWh},$ then the rate of change of the energy consumption is $\frac{\text{d}E}{\text{d}t},$ where $t$ is the time in weeks.

Since an additional $1\,\text{kWh}$ is consumed every week, the rate of change of the energy consumption is given by the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}E}{\text{d}t}=1.
$$
